newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Tennis-Australia go 1-0 up in Davis Cup tie.
newsitem.headline: Tennis-Australia go 1-0 up in Davis Cup tie.

text.p: Australia took a 1-0 lead in its Davis Cup quarter-final tie against the Czech Republic on Friday when Pat Rafter beat Martin Damm in the opening singles rubber.
Rafter beat Damm 6-1 7-6 (9-7) 4-6 6-4 in two hours and 41 minutes.
Rafter took only 26 minutes to snare the first set 6-1 before his opponent settled into the match.
The Australian number two snared the second set 7-6 after Damm wasted a set point during a tense tie-break.
Damm fought back to take the third set 6-4 at Memorial Drive but had little reply to Rafter's superior game in the final set.
The second singles tie was to pit Australia's big-serving Mark Philippoussis against David Rikl.
